paper.title_en: Spherically-symmetric solutions with internal Ricci-flat spaces in Brans-Dicke theory
paper.abstract_en: We construct a new family of exact spherically symmetric solutions in $D$-dimensional Brans-Dicke theory with $n$ internal Ricci-flat spaces. The spacetime is assumed to be a product of a four-dimensional spherical sector and $n$ Ricci-flat internal manifolds. By performing a conformal transformation to the Einstein frame, the problem is reduced to Einstein gravity with a minimally coupled scalar field, for which the exact solution is already known. Applying the inverse transformation to the Jordan frame yields explicit expressions for the metric and the Brans-Dicke scalar field, together with a generalized algebraic constraint on the exponents. The obtained solutions generalize the four-dimensional Brans solutions and the multidimensional solutions with Ricci-flat internal spaces. We analyze the causal structure of the four-dimensional section and derive the necessary condition for the surface $R=L$ to be an event horizon, $ν\equiv \left|a+b+\frac12\sum_i a_iN_i\right| \ge 1$. A Kretschmann-scalar analysis shows that, apart from the Schwarzschild limit and the case of frozen internal spaces, a regular horizon is generically absent when the extra dimensions are dynamical. For the four-dimensional section we also obtain the photon-sphere and ISCO radii and discuss their Schwarzschild limits. The results clarify the role of nonminimal Brans-Dicke coupling in multidimensional black-hole geometries with Ricci-flat internal factors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在Brans-Dicke理论中构造了含Ricci平坦内部空间的多维球对称精确解，利用共形变换映射到Einstein框架并结合已知解，给出Jordan框架下的显式度规与标量场及广义代数约束；随后分析了四维截面的因果结构、事件视界存在条件、Kretschmann标量奇异性、光子球与ISCO半径。问题明确、推导链条完整、结论含明确的否定性结果（额外维动力学时一般不存在正则视界），对多维黑洞几何与非最小耦合研究有参考价值。论文为新近预印本，零引用属中性，不影响评分。
decision.title_zh: Brans-Dicke理论中带内部Ricci平坦空间的球对称解
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了$D$维Brans-Dicke理论中带$n$个内部Ricci平坦空间的一族新的精确球对称解。假定时空是四维球对称扇区与$n$个Ricci平坦内部流形的乘积。通过施行到Einstein框架的共形变换，问题被约化为含最小耦合标量场的Einstein引力，其精确解已知。将逆变换应用于Jordan框架，给出了度规与Brans-Dicke标量场的显式表达式，以及关于指数的广义代数约束。所得解推广了四维Brans解与带Ricci平坦内部空间的多维解。我们分析了四维截面的因果结构，并导出了曲面$R=L$成为事件视界的必要条件，$\nu\equiv \left|a+b+\frac12\sum_i a_iN_i\right| \ge 1$。Kretschmann标量分析表明，除Schwarzschild极限与内部空间冻结的情形之外，当额外维为动力学时一般不存在正则视界。对于四维截面，我们还得到了光子球半径与ISCO半径，并讨论了它们的Schwarzschild极限。结果澄清了非最小Brans-Dicke耦合在带Ricci平坦内部因子的多维黑洞几何中的作用。
